subject: QuillPoint eval activation & integration canvas
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Warren <emily.warren@quillpoint.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: QuillPoint eval activation & integration canvas

Hi Emily — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move the eval to an activation-ready POC:

1) Success criteria (high level) — please confirm these are aligned:
   - Latency: p50 < 250ms for 512-token requests; p95 < 600ms.
   - Throughput: support sustained 150 rps for concurrent test runs; burst to 300rps for short periods.
   - Cost target: <$0.60 per 1k input+output tokens (goal to evaluate cost profile).
   - Quality: accuracy / intent-extraction F1 >= 0.85 on your golden prompt set.
   - Stability: no more than 1% error rate during a 72-hour soak test.

2) Evaluation plan / timeline:
   - Week 0 (this week): finalize success criteria and sign mutual MOPs/POC SOW.
   - Week 1: Redwood provides sandbox credentials + sample integration (SDK snippet + streaming example).
   - Week 2: QuillPoint runs integration tests with 1k golden prompts, records metrics.
   - Week 3: Load test, soak test, and iterate on model variant / quantization settings.

3) Integration checklist (technical):
   - Primary API route: POST /v1/generate (sync) and /v1/stream (SSE) for low-latency streaming.
   - Websocket option: if you prefer bi-directional streaming we'll provide ws:// and auth token example.
   - Tool calling: function schema and example payloads (we'll include example function defs for entity extraction and external DB calls).
   - SDKs: Node and Python examples; sample patch included (sdk-route-sample.patch).
   - Observability: token-level cost traces + latency per-call; we will provide a dashboard link.

4) Ownership:
   - Redwood sales/POC: Jordan Blake (coordination, acceptance).
   - Redwood integration lead: Marissa Cole (SDK samples, instrumentation, streaming config).
   - Redwood procurement: Ben Carter (SOW, billing).
   - QuillPoint engineering lead: Emily Warren (integration, test runs).

Attachments: qp-eval-success-criteria.xlsx (proposed KPIs), SDK example patch.

Please review the success criteria in the attached spreadsheet and confirm the timeline. If that aligns, Ben will start the procurement SOW and Marissa will share the integration snippets by Wednesday.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

--

From: Emily Warren <emily.warren@quillpoint.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QuillPoint eval activation & integration canvas

Jordan — appreciate the clear summary. High-level confirmation from our side:

- Success criteria: agreed in principle. A few clarifications: the 150 rps target is for our aggregated multi-tenant simulator; can we work up a baseline at 100 rps first and then ramp?
- Quality metric: we'll send the golden prompt set early this week (subset to start).
- Cost: QuillPoint's benchmark target is ~$0.50/1k tokens; we understand this is dependent on model/quantization.

Technical notes / asks:
- We will prefer SSE streaming on /v1/stream to minimize client reconnects. If the websocket option is straightforward, keep it as a fallback.
- Tool calling: please include an example where the model returns a function call for an external lookup (we want deterministic function signatures).
- SDKs: Node example is highest priority for our front-end; Python for backend.

Timeline: ramp plan sounds good. We can sign a short mutual SOW once Ben shares the template. Procurement will need an estimate for committed capacity to attach to the SOW — any rough numbers you can provide now will help (GPU-hours or seat commitments).

I'll loop in procurement in a follow-up thread with budgets. Attached: approval note (will send NDA separately — procurement@quillpoint.ai on cc).

Thanks,
Emily Warren
Head of Engineering — QuillPoint Labs
emily.warren@quillpoint.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Warren <emily.warren@quillpoint.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QuillPoint eval activation & integration canvas

Thanks Emily — good call to stage the ramp. A few concrete follow-ups and owners: 

- Marissa will send the Node + Python SDK snippets and an SSE vs WS decision matrix by EOD Thursday. The SDK will include: auth example (Bearer token), streaming with reconnect guidance, and how to attach a function schema for tool calling.

- For the tool-calling example: we will provide a JSON-RPC-like function schema and a published example where the model returns: 
    {
      "name": "fetch_customer_profile",
      "arguments": {"customer_id": "string"}
    }
  plus the recommended signature for safe execution in your infra.

- Observability hooks: include per-call trace_id header X-Trace-Id and a sample cURL to fetch a trace from the Redwood Console API. That will let you correlate model output quality with token-level cost.

- Load testing plan: Redwood will provide a k6 script that hits /v1/stream with your golden prompts and ramps to 100 rps baseline, then +50 rps every 24 hours per your ramp plan. We'll iterate on batching/window parameters and a quantization matrix (int8 vs int4) to meet the cost target.

- Procurement / commitments: Ben — we need a conservative committed capacity estimate for the SOW. Emily, suggest the following placeholder for discussion: 250k generated tokens/day for 30 days (we'll convert to GPU-hour estimate once Marissa shares a perf profile).

Next steps (owners & dates):
  - Ben: share SOW template and preliminary pricing by Friday (20 Nov).
  - Marissa: SDK samples, streaming decision matrix, and k6 script by Thu (19 Nov).
  - Jordan: consolidate acceptance criteria spreadsheet and open HubSpot deal QP-2026-087 (link included).
  - Emily: share golden prompt subset and confirm procurement contact (procurement@quillpoint.ai) by Thu (19 Nov).

I'll attach the acceptance spreadsheet as a living doc (qp-eval-success-criteria.xlsx). If that all looks good, Ben can initiate the procurement run and we'll schedule a 30-minute technical handoff with your engineers next Tuesday.

Best,
Jordan
